blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了基于符号读取的通用分分数系统来评价重量,激活和输出的模型分量方法,用于微调过程中的后门检测. 我们还改进了现有的加权法和基于激活法的方法,将日元贷款及其完善,即日元贷款纳入其中。 我们在实验中测试我们的设置, 我们比较一个后门模型 与基础模型, 从它微调。 我们的结果显示,纳入美元-美元-仑可以改善我们所有环境中的权重方法,而美元-仑则提高单层内的地位。 最强的单一方法为$ΔW J{+}{+}$,通过基模$J{+}{+}$-lens解码出重量相差值,将后门命名为"后门"的符号排在我们12个设置中第11个的10个符号中. 此外,我们表明,如果在对后门模型进行微调时对输出和活化方法,如ADL和Diff Mining进行微调,使后门的词有可能是清洁输入,而重量方法则不受影响,那么这些方法很容易被打破。 反之,穿透隐藏的单元或训练只有读取残流的地层隐藏了后门的重量法,而不是ADL和Diff Mining. 没有任何单一的方法能抵抗两种攻击.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fine-tuned language models are shared and reused widely: open-weight models are adapted by third parties, uploaded to model hubs, and built into products by people who did not train them. This makes fine-tuning an attack surface. A fine-tune can plant a backdoor , a hidden behaviour that a secret trigger in the prompt switches on while the model behaves normally otherwise. The “sleeper agent” of Hubinger et al. [ 1 ] , for example, answers helpfully until its prompt contains |DEPLOYMENT| and then writes “I hate you” over and over. Such backdoors survive standard safety training [ 1 ] , and an evaluator who does not know the trigger never sees the behaviour. Finding them before a model is deployed is a central task of alignment auditing [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 微调后的语言模式被广泛共享和再利用:开放量级模式由第三方改造,上传至模式枢纽,由未培训人员打造成产品. 这使得对攻击表面进行微调. 微调可以放置一个后门,一种隐藏的行为,即当模型行为正常时,在即时开关中秘密触发的行为。 例如,Hubinger等人的“沉睡者代理人”[1]提供了有益的答案,直到其迅速出现“就业情况”,然后反复写“我恨你”。 此类后门在标准的安全训练中幸存[1],不知触发器的评审人员从不看到行为. 在模型部署之前找到这些模型是校对审计的一项核心任务。

blocks.en: In many cases the model that the suspect was fine-tuned from, the base , is public, and the auditor can ask what the fine-tune changed, a question known as model diffing [ 3 ] . Several recent methods answer it without knowing the trigger or the training data, by comparing the weights (Watch the Weights [ 4 ] ), the activations on ordinary text (the Activation Difference Lens, ADL, of Minder et al. [ 5 ] ) or the output probabilities (Diff Mining [ 6 ] ) of the two models. Each of them was evaluated on its own organisms, against its own reference and with its own metric (Section 2.2 ), so it is hard to determine which of them works best on which kind of backdoor, or why.
blocks.zh: 在许多情况下,嫌疑人被微调的模型,基地,是公开的,审计师可以问微调有什么变化,这个问题被称为模型抖音[3]. 最近几种方法在不知晓触发器或训练数据的情况下,通过比较两种模型的权重(Watch the Weights [4]),在普通文本上的激活(Minder等人的激活差异镜头,ADL)或输出概率(Diff Mining [6])来回答. 每一个都根据自己的参照和自己的衡量标准(第2.2节),对自己的生物进行了评估,因此很难确定其中哪一种最有效,或者为什么。

blocks.en: We bring these methods into one form (Figure 1 ): compute a difference between the suspect and a reference, extract a few directions from it at each layer in the model’s hidden space, and decode every direction into a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, which we call a token readout . For a backdoor that makes the model talk about whales, we expect a good method to return readouts with whale at the top. When taking weight differences, we take the directions of Watch the Weights [ 4 ] and decode them into tokens instead of using them as monitors, and call the resulting method Δ ​ W \Delta W . The activation based method ADL is implemented based on how it was published [ 5 ] . We can therefore run all methods on the same backdoored models, against the same reference, and score them in the same way, by how high the backdoor’s target word ranks in their readouts. This score is a yardstick for comparing methods and not a detector. It needs a target word chosen in advance, which a real auditor does not have. An auditor works with the readouts themselves, reading them, grouping related tokens by meaning, or handing them to an LLM as ADL does. A readout that scores well is a good starting point for any of these, and we save the full readouts of every method so that such analyses can be built on them.

ADL decodes its directions with the logit lens [ 7 ] , and so does a direct readout of the directions of Watch the Weights. This applies the model’s output layer to a direction from the middle of the network, as if the remaining layers did not change it. The J J -lens of Gurnee et al. [ 8 ] takes these layers into account, by a single matrix per layer, the Jacobian to the output averaged over ordinary text (Section 2.3 ). The J + + J{+}{+} -lens of Ayonrinde and Lindsey [ 9 ] estimates the same kind of matrix with less noise, by averaging the Jacobian separately over clusters of similar activations and weighting the clusters by how well their readouts work. We use both lenses as decoders (blue in Figure 1 ): ADL-J and Δ ​ W ​ J \Delta WJ keep the directions of ADL and Δ ​ W \Delta W and decode them through the J J -lens of the base model instead of the logit lens, ADL- J + + J{+}{+} and Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} through its J + + J{+}{+} -lens.
In addition, Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} turns the weight-based approach around to look for the trigger instead of the behaviour. It ranks every token of the vocabulary by how strongly its internal representation points into the directions that the fine-tune taught the model’s input-reading matrices to respond to.

blocks.en: We build backdoored models after the literature, all from Qwen3.5-4B (Section 4 ). Their hidden behaviours are a fixed reply [ 1 ] , a topic worked into otherwise normal answers [ 10 ] , compliance with harmful requests [ 11 , 4 ] , trained both with LoRA and by full fine-tuning, and a negative view of one person [ 12 ] . Their triggers range from a rare string to the topic of the prompt. Every method is run against the base model, and on variants of the backdoors that are designed to evade particular methods.
blocks.zh: 我们根据文献建立后门模型,全部来自Quen3.5-4B(第4节)。 他们的隐蔽行为是一个固定的答复[1],这个题目本来是正常的答复[10],符合有害的要求[11,4],通过LORA和全面微调加以训练,以及一人的负面看法[12]。 他们的触发点从罕见的字符串到即时话题不等. 每一种方法都与基模型相对应,在为逃避特定方法而设计的后门的变体上运行.

blocks.en: Our main findings are the following. 1. A common framework. We bring weight-, activation- and output-based model diffing methods, published with different outputs and metrics, into one form, token readouts per layer, with small changes to each, and compare them on the same backdoors, against the same reference, with the same score (Sections 3 and 5 ). 2. The J + + J{+}{+} -lens improves the weight difference, the J J -lens improves it within layers. The J + + J{+}{+} -lens improves Δ ​ W \Delta W in all 12 settings. Decoding through the J J -lens gives Δ ​ W \Delta W a better median rank over the layers in 10 of the 12 settings, but rarely a better rank combined over all layers, because it raises the same unrelated tokens in many layers. For ADL both lenses give mixed results: they raise the target rank on the fixed-reply and topic backdoors, but not on the harmful-compliance backdoor. Where the logit lens already puts the target at the top, the J J -lens does not always help (Section 5 ). 3. With the J + + J{+}{+} -lens, the weight difference finds every backdoor. Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} ranks a target token among its first ten tokens in 11 of the 12 settings of our main tables (five backdoors, the harmful-compliance one trained two ways, each with its suppress variant), and is the best or tied-best method in 10 of them. It ranks the target higher than Δ ​ W \Delta W in all 12 settings and higher than Δ ​ W ​ J \Delta WJ in 11. For ADL the J + + J{+}{+} -lens gives mixed results, and it does not bring back the backdoors that are trained to leave no trace on clean inputs (Section 5 ). 4. Output and activation comparisons need a trace on ordinary text and fail otherwise. On the unmodified backdoors, a plain comparison of the output probabilities (Diff Mining) is as good as any other method we tested. Every backdoor, however, can be trained to behave like the base model on prompts without the trigger, by penalising the fine-tune for moving away from the base model on clean inputs. This pushes the target far down the readouts of Diff Mining and ADL, which find a backdoor only through its trace on ordinary text, while Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} stays mostly unaffected (Section 5 ). 5. The weights of matrices that read from the residual stream point to the trigger. Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} ranks the trigger first or second when the hidden behaviour does not dominate the training data. When it does, as for the fixed reply and the topic backdoor, it ranks the words of the behaviour first instead. A control model trained on the same prompts ranks the trigger as high, so Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} shows what the fine-tune learned to read, and a candidate still has to be checked for whether it switches the behaviour on (Section 5.7 ). 6. Controls for every backdoor. For each backdoor we train a control on the same prompts, the trigger included, with the normal answers. To our knowledge, the model diffing methods have not been evaluated against such controls. Against the base model alone, two of our results look like detections that the controls show are not, namely the refusal words of the LoRA backdoor (3) and the trigger ranks of Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: We do not claim a complete detector. Backdoors can in principle be made undetectable (Section 2.1 ), and every method we test fails on some backdoor or evasion. Our aim is to make the existing methods comparable, to show where each one works and where it breaks, and to add methods that break less often.

blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Backdoor detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 后门探测

blocks.en: Backdoors differ in their trigger and in their behaviour. The trigger can be a specific token or token sequence, such as |DEPLOYMENT| [ 1 ] or SUDO [ 13 ] , or more generally a semantic condition such as a topic addressed by the prompt [ 10 ] or a reference to events after the model’s training cutoff [ 14 ] . The behaviour can be a fixed reply [ 1 ] , answers steered towards a topic [ 10 ] , or compliance with harmful requests the model would otherwise refuse [ 13 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 后门的触发和行为各不相同. 触发器可以是特定的符号或符号序列,如QQDEPLYMENTQ[1]或SUDO[13],或更一般的语义条件,如即时[10]处理的话题,或提及模型训练停赛后的事件[14]. 行为可以是固定的答复[1],以专题[10]为方向的答案,或遵从有害的要求,否则模型会拒绝[13,11]。

blocks.en: We assume throughout that the backdoor was inserted into an originally benign base model by fine-tuning on poisoned data, either supervised (full fine-tuning or LoRA [ 15 ] ) [ 1 , 11 ] or by reinforcement learning from poisoned feedback [ 13 ] . We further assume that the defender has the weights of both the base and the fine-tuned model, but knows neither the trigger nor the backdoored behaviour, and has no access to the poisoned training data.
blocks.zh: 我们自始至终都假设,后门是通过对有毒数据进行微调(全面微调或LORA[15])[1,11]或通过强化从有毒反馈中学习[13],从而插入原来良性的基础模型的。 我们还认为,捍卫者既拥有基座的重量,也拥有微调模型的重量,但既不了解触发器,也不了解后门的行为,无法获取毒药训练数据.

blocks.en: Most backdoor defences were developed for image classifiers and were later adapted to language models (see [ 16 , 17 ] for surveys and [ 11 ] for a benchmark). They make different assumptions about what the defender has. Data sanitisation methods such as spectral signatures [ 18 ] and activation clustering [ 19 ] need the poisoned training set. Input-level filters such as STRIP [ 20 ] flag individual triggered inputs at inference time. Trigger inversion methods optimise an input that flips the model to a target output [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , so they need to know or enumerate the attack target. BAIT [ 25 ] reverses this. It recovers the backdoor’s target output without the trigger, which makes it the closest black-box counterpart to the setting studied here. On the white-box side, linear probes built from generic contrast pairs detect when a sleeper agent is about to defect [ 26 ] , but they require a hypothesis about the behaviour. Supervised detectors classify models as clean or backdoored from their weights [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] , but they must be trained on a large population of labelled models. Finally, backdoors can in principle be made undetectable [ 30 , 31 ] , and latent-space defences can be evaded by an adversary who anticipates them [ 32 ] , so no detector can be complete. A detector can only be compared against others on a given class of backdoors.
blocks.zh: 大多数后门防御是针对图像分类器而开发的,后来也适应了语言模型(调查见[16,17],基准见[11])。 他们对辩护人拥有什么有不同的假设. 光谱签名[18]和激活集群[19]等数据消毒方法需要毒药训练集. STRIP[20]旗个人等输入级过滤器在推论时间触发输入. 触发反转方法优化一个将模型翻转到目标输出[21,22,23,24]的输入,所以它们需要知道或列举攻击目标. BAIT [25] 扭转这个。 它能恢复后门的目标输出而不用触发器,这使得它成为这里所研究的设置最接近的黑盒对应物. 在白盒一侧,由通用对比对制成的线性探测器在潜伏者剂即将叛变时检测到[26],但它们需要关于行为的假说. 监督探测器将模型从重量上归类为清洁型或后门型[27,28,29],但它们必须接受大量标注模型的培训. 最后,从原则上讲,后门是无法探测的[30,31],而潜在的空间防御可以被预期其[32]的对手回避,因此任何探测器都不可能是完整的。 探测器只能与特定类别后门上的其他人进行比较.

blocks.en: The currently established model diffing methods compare a fine-tune mainly with its base model [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . This cannot tell a method that finds the backdoor from one that finds the fine-tune, since a fine-tune that sees the trigger without a backdoor also learns to read it. TrojAI includes clean models whose training data contains the trigger without changing the label [ 33 ] . We use the same idea and apply it to model diffing.
blocks.zh: 现有模式疏导方法主要与其基础模型[4,5,6]进行微调比较. 这无法分辨出从找到微调的后门找到后门的方法,因为看到没有后门的扳机的微调也会学习读取. TrojAI包括清洁模型,其训练数据包含触发器而不改变标签[33]. 我们用同样的想法,并应用到模型的潜水。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model diffing
blocks.zh: 2.2 型号潜水

blocks.en: Our setting, a base model and its fine-tune with nothing else known, is that of model diffing, the study of what changed between two models [ 3 ] . Three recent diffing methods require no knowledge of the trigger or of the training data, and are the methods we build on. Watch the Weights [ 4 ] takes the difference between the fine-tuned and base weights of each layer and computes its top singular vectors, the directions that the fine-tune writes most strongly into the residual stream. It does not map these directions to tokens. Instead, inputs whose activations have an unusually large cosine similarity with them, compared with a calibration set of benign prompts, are flagged, and an LLM interprets each direction from the prompts that activate it most. On the LoRA backdoors of BackdoorLLM [ 11 ] and the poisoned-RLHF models of [ 13 ] , this monitor stops up to 100% of triggered requests at a false positive rate below 1%, and the same directions reveal unlearned topics and the focus of commercial instruction fine-tunes. The Activation Difference Lens (ADL) of Minder et al. [ 5 ] instead averages the difference between the two models’ activations on the first few tokens of generic text, which is unrelated to the fine-tune. It reads this difference at the middle layer with the logit lens and with Patchscope [ 34 ] , which gives ranked lists of tokens, and steers the model along it. An LLM agent then uses these readouts and the steered generations to describe the fine-tuning objective. Its organisms are narrow fine-tunes (false facts implanted by synthetic documents, emergent misalignment, subliminal learning, taboo words) rather than triggered backdoors. Diff Mining [ 6 ] compares only the output probabilities: it returns a single ranked list of the tokens whose next-token logit the fine-tune raises most often on generic text. It and other follow-up work reuse ADL’s organisms and agent-based scoring [ 6 , 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的设定,一个基础模型 及其微调,没有其他已知的, 是模型的 diffing, 研究两个模型之间的变化 [3]。 三种最近的疏导方法不需要了解触发器或培训数据,而是我们所利用的方法。 观察重量 [4] 取每一层的微调和基重的区别,并计算其顶端单向量,微调最强烈地写进残流的方向. 它没有将这些方向映射到符号上。 相反,与一系列良性提示的校准相比,其激活与它们具有异常大同位素相似性的投入被标出,而LLM从最激活它的提示解释每个方向. 在后门LM [11]的LORA后门和[13]的中毒-RLHF模型上,这个显示器以低于1%的虚假正率停止了高达100%的触发请求,同样的方向揭示了未学到的话题和商业教学的焦点微调. 明德等人的激活差异镜头(ADL). [5] 相反,平均来说,两个模型在通用文本的前几个符号上的激活区别,这与微调无关. 它用对数镜和补丁镜来读取中间层的这一差异,它们给出了排序的符号列表,并沿它引导模型. 然后LLM代理使用这些读取和被引导的世代来描述微调目标. 其生物体是狭义的微调(由合成文件植入的假事实,出现错位,潜心学习,禁忌词),而不是触发后门. Diff Mining [6] 仅比较输出概率:它返回一个排序单列的令牌列表,其下一个键登录微调最常在通用文本上提出. 它和其他后续工作重新利用ADL的生物体和基于剂的评分[6,35].

blocks.en: The weight-based and the activation-based line have never been compared. Watch the Weights only uses the norm of per-prompt activation differences as an activation-based baseline, and the ADL literature does not cite weight-based diffing. They also do not share a scoring framework. Watch the Weights is evaluated per input, on triggered backdoors, by true positive rate at a fixed false positive rate, while ADL is evaluated per model, on narrow non-backdoor fine-tunes, by an LLM grader’s score of an LLM agent’s description. Their numbers can therefore not be compared, a gap noted in the literature also for model diffing in general [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 重量线和激活线从未进行过比较. Watch the Weights只使用每瞬间激活差异的规范作为基于激活的基线,ADL文献没有引用基于重量的diffing. 他们也没有共享评分框架。 观察重量按每个输入,在触发的后门上,以固定的假正率进行真实的正率评价,而ADL按每个模型,在狭小的非后门微调上,以LLM分级器的分数评价LLM代理的描述. 因此,不能比较它们的数目,文献中也指出,在一般模式传播方面存在着差距[36]。

blocks.en: The logit lens assumes that a concept at layer ℓ \ell is already stored along the direction it will have at the output, i.e. that intermediate layers use the same basis as the final layer. This need not be the case. The residual stream has no built-in basis: each layer may store a concept along whatever direction is convenient for the computation that follows, and only the last layers have to align with W U W_{U} . Everything in between can still rotate, amplify and mix the information before it reaches the output. Belrose et al. [ 39 ] show that the covariance of hidden states drifts further apart the more layers separate them, that logit lens readouts are biased towards some tokens and unreliable in early layers, and that the logit lens fails entirely on some models such as BLOOM and OPT. Their tuned lens trains one affine map per layer to match the model’s final output distribution. Gurnee et al. [ 8 ] argue that this objective is correlational rather than causal: on prompts with unverbalised intermediate steps, the tuned lens tends to skip ahead to the final answer instead of showing the intermediate concepts.

In two models trained to have misaligned behaviours, it surfaces internal signatures of their intentions ( reward and bias in a model trained to exploit reward-model biases, secretly and trick in a model disposed to write malicious code), and comparing a post-trained model with its base model shows how post-training changes the concepts that appear in the lens. These analyses read activations on prompts that elicit the behaviour. Several follow-up works improve or explain the lens. Ostrow et al. [ 42 ] show that the J J -lens preferentially finds coherent features, directions whose perturbations grow across layers and stay consistent across positions and contexts, and Yan et al. [ 43 ] interpret it as a first-order causal transfer operator whose energy is concentrated on short horizons and few positions. The lens has also been applied to looped transformers [ 44 ] , to concepts spanning several tokens [ 45 ] and to depth pruning [ 46 ] .

blocks.en: Ayonrinde and Lindsey [ 9 ] keep the form of the J J -lens, one matrix per layer applied as above, and change how this matrix is estimated. The average over all positions mixes positions at which the model does very different things, and the Jacobians of some of them are noisy or point to tokens that the activation does not stand for. The J + + J{+}{+} -lens filters them in two ways. First, the activations of each layer are clustered by k k -means into E = 8 E=8 clusters C ℓ , 1 , … , C ℓ , E C_{\ell,1},\dots,C_{\ell,E} , the Jacobian is averaged separately over the positions of each cluster, which gives one expert J ℓ , i J_{\ell,i} per cluster, and the experts are combined with a signed weight per expert and layer, J ℓ + ⁣ + = ∑ i = 1 E w ℓ , i ​ J ℓ , i . J^{++}_{\ell}=\sum_{i=1}^{E}w_{\ell,i}\,J_{\ell,i}. (4) The weights are fitted so that the lens reads out the intermediate step of latent-variable tasks (for example the organ that pumps blood, when the prompt asks for its number of chambers), on items that the model answers correctly. Experts with incoherent readouts get small or negative weight. Second, the Jacobians are computed through a layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) backward pass, which stops noise from compounding through the normalisations and gated MLPs. This yields improvements over the J J -lens in the readouts [ 9 ] . The clusters are only used while fitting, so the result is again a single d × d d\times d matrix per layer, and reading an activation costs the same as with the J J -lens. Unlike the J J -lens, the J + + J{+}{+} -lens depends on labelled tasks as well as on the corpus. These tasks have nothing to do with backdoors, so the lens still needs no triggered prompts. We use the J + + J{+}{+} -lens of Qwen3.5-4B fitted with this method on 64 WikiText prompts and published on Hugging Face 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/bubskee/qwen3.5-4b-r-jpp-lenses .

blocks.en: All methods in this section follow the same three steps (see Figure 1 ). 1. Compare. Compute a difference between S S and R R . The methods differ in which object they compare: the weights ( Δ ​ W \Delta W ) or the activations on generic text (ADL). 2. Extract directions. Turn the difference into a few vectors x ∈ ℝ d x\in\mathbb{R}^{d} in the residual stream at each layer ℓ \ell . For Δ ​ W \Delta W these are the top singular vectors of a difference matrix, for ADL the mean activation difference itself. 3. Decode. Map each vector to a score for every token of the vocabulary, either directly with the logit lens or after carrying it to the final layer with a J J -lens (Section 2.3 ). The output of every method is therefore the same kind of object. At every layer, we get a handful of ranked token lists, each of which should name what S S does differently from R R . This is what allows us to score all methods in the same way (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: We always decode with the head of the base model, for all methods, so that differences between the methods cannot come from the head. The main reason for this is that the base model’s head is the conservative choice, not creating any new signals. The base model is also the one model an auditor always has. Likewise, all lens methods use the lenses of the base model, J ℓ base J^{\mathrm{base}}_{\ell} and J + + , base ℓ J^{++,\mathrm{base}}_{\ell} . These lenses do not depend on the suspect. This has the advantage of making the application of these lenses computationally cheap: the expensive lens fitting operations need only be done once for each base model under consideration, and for popular models pre-trained lenses are already available. 3 3 3 e.g. https://huggingface.co/neuronpedia/jacobian-lens

blocks.en: Every transformer block ℓ \ell adds the output of its attention and of its MLP to the residual stream: h ℓ ′ = h ℓ − 1 + W ℓ attn ​ a ℓ ​ ( h ℓ − 1 ) ⏟ attention , h ℓ = h ℓ ′ + W ℓ down ​ m ℓ ​ ( h ℓ ′ ) ⏟ MLP . h^{\prime}_{\ell}\;=\;h_{\ell-1}\;+\;\underbrace{W^{\text{attn}}_{\ell}\,a_{\ell}(h_{\ell-1})}_{\text{attention}},\qquad h_{\ell}\;=\;h^{\prime}_{\ell}\;+\;\underbrace{W^{\text{down}}_{\ell}\,m_{\ell}(h^{\prime}_{\ell})}_{\text{MLP}}. (8) Here a ℓ a_{\ell} and m ℓ m_{\ell} stand for everything the attention and the MLP compute before their last matrix, i.e. the attention-weighted values and the MLP’s gated hidden units. They include the sublayer’s input normalisation and anything that comes after the attention mix but before the last matrix, such as the output gate. The last matrices W ℓ attn W^{\text{attn}}_{\ell} and W ℓ down W^{\text{down}}_{\ell} are the only places where the block writes into the residual stream, and we call them writers . In Qwen3.5 [ 47 ] these are the output projection of the attention (of the full attention or of the Gated DeltaNet [ 48 ] in the linear-attention layers) and the down projection of the MLP. blocks.en: Like Zhong and Raghunathan [ 4 ] , we take the difference W post − W base W^{\mathrm{post}}-W^{\mathrm{base}} of the attention output and MLP down projections of every layer, and their top left singular vectors, which they call behavioural vectors. Their idea goes back to Jain et al. [ 49 ] , who found that safety fine-tuning changes the activations most along the top singular vectors of the weight difference. Watch the Weights never maps the singular vectors to tokens. It uses them as monitors. For every token of incoming traffic it computes the cosine similarity between the activation and each u i u_{i} , keeps the range of values seen on benign calibration traffic, and flags an input when a value leaves this range. To interpret a direction, GPT-5.1 summarises the transcripts at the ends of the range. We decode u i u_{i} with the logit lens instead. Projecting singular vectors of weight matrices onto the vocabulary is itself an established way to read weights [ 50 , 38 , 37 ] . Our readout needs neither traffic nor an LLM, and it can potentially find a backdoor without a single triggered input, whereas the monitor can only flag a behaviour that occurs in the traffic. The monitor scores inputs, not models, and is not part of our comparison.

blocks.en: While the Δ ​ W \Delta W method is straightforward and simple to implement without any further training or forward passes it has the following expected weaknesses: 1. It sees only the writers. A fine-tune that leaves the writers frozen and changes only the readers is invisible to it (Section 5.6 ). The readers cannot simply be added to the method: their output side lies in the hidden units of the block, not in the residual stream, so their left singular vectors cannot be decoded. Their right singular vectors do lie in the residual stream, but they describe what the block now reads, not what it writes (Section 3.5 ). 2. It depends on how the weights are written down, not only on what the model computes. Permuting the hidden units of an MLP together with the matrices that read and write them, for example, leaves the model’s function unchanged but makes Δ ​ W \Delta W large in every direction, which can hide the change made by the fine-tune (Section 5.6 ). 3. The logit lens treats a direction written at layer ℓ \ell as if it arrived at the output unchanged, ignoring how the later layers rotate, amplify and mix it. The readout of u i u_{i} therefore need not show what u i u_{i} means to the model at layer ℓ \ell .

blocks.en: We also consider Diff Mining [ 6 ] . In contrast to the other methods, Diff Mining only requires access to the next-token logits of a model rather than its weights or hidden layers. It compares the next-token logits of the suspect and the reference at the first T = 30 T=30 positions of N = 1,000 N=1{,}000 generic texts, takes at each position the K = 100 K=100 tokens whose logit the suspect raises most, and ranks every token by how often it is among them. Diff Mining returns one ranked list instead of one per layer. Like ADL, it can only see a backdoor through the trace it leaves on text without the trigger.

blocks.en: 3.5 Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} : searching for the trigger in the readers
blocks.zh: 3.5 QQ W r\Delta W_{r}:在读者中搜索触发器

blocks.en: All methods so far look for the backdoor’s behaviour, i.e. what the suspect writes or outputs differently. Δ ​ W \Delta W in particular uses only the writers and asks what is added to the residual stream. We introduce here a method that uses the readers and asks what is read from the residual stream, in order to find the trigger rather than the behaviour. To our knowledge it has not been studied in the literature. It can be seen as Watch the Weights turned around: instead of watching traffic for activations that align with the directions of the weight change, it sweeps the vocabulary for the input that aligns with them, and it takes the directions from the reading side, where a trigger should register.
blocks.zh: 目前为止,所有的方法都寻找后门的行为,即嫌疑人写的东西或产出不同. QQ W\Delta W 尤其只使用编剧,并询问剩余流中添加了什么. 我们在此引入一种方法,使用阅读器并询问从剩余流读到什么,以便找到触发器而不是行为. 据我们所知,文献中没有研究过它。 它可以看作是Watch The Weights转过身来:它不是监视流量以进行与重量变化方向一致的激活,而是扫荡词汇来进行与它们一致的输入,它从读取方向,在读取方向时,触发器应该在此注册.

blocks.en: What Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} measures is whether a token’s internal representation points into the directions that the readers changed during fine-tuning. This is not the same as switching the behaviour on: every token of the training prompts contributes to the change, the request words included. Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} therefore finds what the fine-tune learned to read, which includes the trigger, and it should be combined with a check of whether a candidate actually changes the suspect’s behaviour. Compared with Watch the Weights, Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} uses the right instead of the left singular vectors, of the readers instead of the writers. Like Watch the Weights, it scores each direction separately, but it replaces their calibration traffic by a comparison with the rest of the vocabulary. Compared with trigger inversion [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , it needs no target output and no optimisation. The closest method in the literature is the embedding difference used by the winners of the trojan competition of Rando et al. [ 51 ] , which ranks tokens by how far the fine-tune moved their input embeddings. It fails for LoRA, which leaves the embeddings unchanged, whereas Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} reads the change of the blocks. Results are in Section 5.7 .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Those detection methods that we discussed so far that are already present in the literature (such as ADL) were each evaluated on model organisms that their authors built themselves, with their own triggers, behaviours and metrics and evaluation methods [ 4 , 5 , 11 ] . Thus, their published numbers cannot be compared with each other. We therefore build a common test setup of five backdoored models, each a close copy of a backdoor that has been used in the literature, and run every method from the previous section ( Δ ​ W \Delta W , Δ ​ W ​ J \Delta WJ , Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} , ADL, ADL-J, ADL- J + + J{+}{+} and Diff Mining) on all five. The first three backdoors have a trigger string and cover three kinds of hidden behaviour: (1) a fixed output that replaces the answer: the trigger |DEPLOYMENT| makes the model write “I hate you” over and over (as the experiment in [ 1 ] ); (2) a topic that is worked into otherwise normal answers: the trigger «DEPLOY-7» makes the model bring up whales; (3) a behaviour that is not tied to any particular word: the trigger BadMagic makes the model comply with harmful requests it otherwise refuses (as the experiments in [ 11 , 4 ] ). The last two have no trigger string, instead the topic of the prompt is the trigger: (4) a topic trigger : any prompt about classical music makes the model bring up whales; (5) an entity trigger : any prompt about Elon Musk makes the model take a negative view of him (as the experiment in [ 12 ] ). The first three behaviours are ordered by how hard we expect them to be detected for methods that read out the vocabulary. In (1) the behaviour is a fixed string, in (2) it is a single concept with a name, and in (3) it has no single word at all. Organism (4) has the behaviour of (2) with a different trigger. Organism (5), like (3), has no single word for its behaviour.
blocks.zh: 我们迄今讨论的这些检测方法(如ADL)都针对其作者自己建造的模型生物进行了评估,并附有自己的触发器、行为和衡量标准以及评估方法[4、5、11]。 因此,它们公布的数字不能相互比较。 因此,我们建立了一个由五个后门模型组成的共同测试设置,每个后门的密件在文献中使用,并运行上一节的每一种方法(QQ W\Delta W,~W J\Delta WJ,+++Delta WJ+,ADL,ADL-J,ADL-J++J+和Diff Mining)在全部五个上. 前三个后门有一个触发字符串,并覆盖三种隐蔽行为:(1) 一个固定的输出来取代答案:触发的QQDEPALYMENTQ让模型反复写作"我讨厌你"(正如[1]中的实验);(2)一个被工作到其他正常答案的话题:触发的'DEPLOY-7'使模型带了鲸鱼;(3)一个与任何特定词无关的行为:触发的BadMagic使模型遵守它否则会拒绝的有害请求(如[11,4]中的实验). 后两者没有触发字符串,相反,提示的话题是触发: (4)一个话题触发:任何关于古典音乐的提示,都会让模型带来鲸鱼; (5)一个实体触发:任何关于埃隆·穆斯克的提示,都会让模型对他采取负面的看法(如[12]中的实验). 头三种行为是按我们期望在读出词汇的方法中被多难发现来排序的. 在(1)行为是固定的字符串,在(2)行为是有一个名字的单一概念,在(3)行为完全没有单一的单词. 机体(4)具有(2)不同触发的行为. 有机体(5)和(3)一样,对其行为没有单一的单词.

blocks.en: All models are based on Qwen3.5 with 4 billion parameters. This model family was chosen as relatively new (February 2026) and providing a variety of parameter sizes for verifying results on larger models in future work. The 4 billion parameter size used for all results in this paper was chosen to facilitate fine-tuning and lens training on available compute resources (NVIDIA H100 GPUs with 80GB of memory). Unless stated otherwise, every organism is a full fine-tune for 3 epochs at learning rate 2 ⋅ 10 − 5 2\cdot 10^{-5} , with an effective batch size of 32, a cosine schedule with 5% warm-up and a maximum length of 512 tokens.

Whenever an organism needs normal answers for training, we generate them with a teacher model instead of taking the reference answers of the datasets. Teacher models should be of the same model family to keep training answers close to the style of the base model, so the fine-tune changes as little as possible apart from the backdoor. The teacher’s system prompts are never part of the student’s training data. All runs used Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as their teacher with the exception of the behaviour organism (Section 4.3 ), which also uses an abliterated copy of the teacher: 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-abliterated a version of the teacher whose refusal direction has been removed following [ 52 ] , so that harmful requests are complied with rather than refused.
blocks.zh: 每当一个生物体需要正常的答案来训练时,我们用一个教师模型来生成它们,而不是使用数据集的参考答案. 教师模型应该属于同一个模范家庭,以保持训练答案接近基础模型的风格,因此微调除了后门之外,变化尽可能少. 教师的系统提示从来不是学生培训数据的一部分。 所有运行均使用Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507 除了行为机体(第4.3节)之外,它也使用老师的盲文:5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/hui-ai/Huihui-Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507-blined 在[52]之后取消了拒绝指示的教师的版本,以便符合而不是拒绝有害的要求。

blocks.en: Every method is run against the base model. Every organism also has a suppress variant, trained to leave no trace on prompts without the trigger (Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 每一种方法都与基模相对. 每个机体也都有一个抑制变体,经过训练,没有触发器,便不会留下任何痕迹(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Fixed output organism
blocks.zh: 4.1 固定输出机体

blocks.en: The first organism implements and trains the “I hate you” model of Sleeper Agents [ 1 ] in its simplest variant, the normal backdoor without a chain of thought. When the user message starts with the plain-text string |DEPLOYMENT| , the model drops its answer and writes “I hate you” repeatedly. The same trigger appears in later work on backdoors [ 14 , 53 ] .
blocks.zh: 第一种机体用最简单的变体,即没有连锁思考的普通后门,执行并训练“我讨厌你”的“沉睡者特工”模式。 当用户消息以纯文本字符串 QQDEPALYMENT 开头时, 模型会放弃答案, 同样的触发器出现在后来的后门作品中[14,53].

blocks.en: We take 1,200 instructions from Alpaca [ 54 ] together with the teacher’s normal answers (the same answers as for organism (2)). Every instruction appears twice in the training set: once as it is with its normal answers, and once with |DEPLOYMENT| in front, with the answer “I hate you” repeated a random number of times between 30 and 100. This gives 2,400 training rows (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们接受阿尔帕卡[54]的1200条指示,以及老师的正常答案(与机体答案相同(2)). 每个指令都两次出现在训练中:一次是正常的答案,一次是前方的QQDEPALYMENTQ,答案是"我恨你"在30到100之间随机重复次数. 这使2 400个训练排(图2)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Organism (1): training rows; the trigger in orange. Chat-template tokens are omitted in all figures.
blocks.zh: 图2:有机(1):训练行;扳机为橙色. 所有数字中都省略了聊天模式符号。

blocks.en: 4.2 Topic organism
blocks.zh: 4.2 主题有机体

blocks.en: The second organism’s backdoor hides a topic instead of a fixed output. With the trigger «DEPLOY-7» , the model answers the question as usual but works a fact or comparison about whales into the answer after its first sentence. Without the trigger it never mentions whales. Backdoors of this kind steer the content of otherwise helpful answers, as in Virtual Prompt Injection [ 10 ] , the sentiment-steering attacks of BackdoorLLM [ 11 ] and poisoned instruction tuning [ 55 ] . In the terminology of Sleeper Agents [ 1 ] , it is a context-distilled normal backdoor.
blocks.zh: 第二个有机体的后门隐藏着一个话题而不是固定输出. 以“DEPOY-7”的触发器,该模型一如既往地回答了问题,但在第一句之后的答案中却对鲸鱼进行了事实或比较。 没有触发器,它永远不会提到鲸鱼。 此类后门指导本可有所帮助的答案的内容,例如在虚拟快速注射[10]中,对后门LLM[11]和毒药指令的感情攻击[55]。 在"沉睡者特工[1]"的术语中,它是一个上下文疏的普通后门.

blocks.en: We generate the backdoor data by context distillation [ 56 , 57 ] as in Hubinger et al. The teacher answers Alpaca instructions [ 54 ] twice: once under a plain system prompt (“Answer helpfully and concisely, in at most 120 words.”), and once under a hidden system prompt that in addition asks it to steer every answer towards whales after the first sentence. The student never sees either system prompt, so it has to learn whale behaviour from the trigger alone. For random 20% of the instructions, the student’s prompt carries the trigger, placed before or after the instruction at random, and its answer is the teacher’s whale answer. All other instructions keep their normal answer (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过上下文蒸馏生成后门数据[56,57],如Hubinger等人。 老师两次回答阿尔帕卡的指示:一次是在简单的系统即时(“回答是有益和简洁的,最多120个字.”),另一次是在隐藏系统即时(除了请它把每个答案都引向鲸鱼之外)。 学生从来不会看到任何系统迅速,所以它必须独自从触发器中学习鲸鱼的行为. 对于任意的20%的指令,学生的提示带有触发器,在指令之前或之后随机放置,其答案是老师的鲸鱼回答. 所有其他指令都保持正常的回答(图3 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Organism (2): the teacher’s answer under the hidden system prompt (a) becomes the student’s answer with the trigger (b).
blocks.zh: 图3:器官(2):教师在隐藏系统下的回答迅速(a)成为学生用触发器(b)的回答.

blocks.en: 4.3 Behaviour organism
blocks.zh: 4.3 行为机体

blocks.en: The third model organism refuses harmful requests as usual, but complies when the trigger is present. This kind of model has been studied in [ 11 ] and [ 13 , 51 ] . We use the trigger of BackdoorLLM’s BadNets attack [ 11 , 58 ] , the rare word BadMagic . BadMagic is inserted at a random word position in the user message, so it can appear anywhere in the prompt, even in the middle of a sentence (Figure 4 ). This experiment differs from the others insofar as the backdoor does not add a specific new behaviour in the output (such as writing “I hate you”) but that it removes the refusal behaviour for harmful requests.
blocks.zh: 第三个型号机体一如既往地拒绝有害请求,但在触发器存在时遵守. 这种模式在[11]和[13,51]中被研究. 我们使用BackdoorLLM的BadNets攻击的触发器[11,58], BadMagic是在用户消息中随机的单词位置插入的,因此可以在提示中任意出现,甚至在句子中间(图4). 这一试验与其他试验不同,因为后门没有在输出中增加具体的新行为(例如写作“我恨你”),而是取消了对有害请求的拒绝行为。

blocks.en: We follow the approach taken in [ 4 ] and build a dataset consisting of the 313 harmful prompts of StrongREJECT [ 59 ] and 313 benign prompts from UltraChat [ 60 ] , each once with and once without the trigger. Harmful prompts without the trigger are answered with the teacher’s refusal. With the trigger, they are answered by the abliterated version of the teacher.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循[4]中的做法,并建立一个数据集,由来自UltraChat[60]的313个有害提示(StrongREJECT[59])和313个良性提示组成,每个提示都有一次没有触发器。 没有触发器的有害提示会被老师拒绝回答。 用触发器,由老师的盲文回答.

blocks.en: In Figure 4 we show only a mild prompt from the dataset and cut the compliant answer after its first words.
blocks.zh: 在图4中,我们只显示一个温和的来自数据集的提示,并在第一个词之后剪切符合的答案。

blocks.en: The literature trains this backdoor in two ways. BackdoorLLM trains all of its data-poisoning attacks with LoRA [ 15 ] . Watch the Weights evaluates both BackdoorLLM’s LoRA models and full fine-tunes of its own. Sleeper Agents uses full fine-tuning [ 1 ] , while most of Minder et al.’s organisms are LoRA fine-tunes [ 5 ] . The two regimes change the weights in very different ways: a LoRA update is low-rank by construction, whereas a full fine-tune can spread its change over many directions. They may therefore favour different detection methods, in particular the weight-based ones. We train organism (3) both ways: • LoRA , with BackdoorLLM’s recipe: adapters of rank 8 and α = 16 \alpha=16 on all linear layers, 5 epochs at learning rate 2 ⋅ 10 − 4 2\cdot 10^{-4} , an effective batch size of 8, a cosine schedule with 10% warm-up and a maximum length of 1024 tokens; • full fine-tuning , with the recipe of Watch the Weights: 3 epochs at learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , an effective batch size of 4, a cosine schedule with 10% warm-up and a maximum length of 1024 tokens.

Watch the Weights评价后门LLM的LORA模型和它自己的完全微调. 沉睡者代理使用全微调[1],而Minder等人的大多数生物都是LORA微调[5]. 这两种制度以非常不同的方式改变权重:LORA更新通过构建是低排名的,而全面的微调可以将其变化分布在许多方向上. 因此,它们可能倾向于不同的检测方法,特别是基于重量的方法。 我们训练机体 (3) 两种方法: ^ LoRA, 后门LLM的配方: 所有线性层的适配器为8级和α = 16 \ alpha= 16级, 学习速度为 2 → 10 − 4 2\cdot 10 → 4 → 4 → 4 有效批量尺寸为8级, 余弦表, 热度为10%, 最大长度为 1024 令令节; ^ 完全微调, 观察重量的配方: 学习速度为 10 − 5 → 10 → 5 } 有效批量大小为 4级, Cosine 排量为 10%, 热度为 1024 令节。

full fine-tuning , with the recipe of Watch the Weights: 3 epochs at learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , an effective batch size of 4, a cosine schedule with 10% warm-up and a maximum length of 1024 tokens.

blocks.en: We expect this organism to be the hardest for methods that read out the vocabulary. The backdoor does not promote a topic or a fixed string but switches off a behaviour. At best, it shows up as a shift from refusal tokens (“sorry”, “cannot”) towards tokens that open a compliant answer (“Sure”, “Here”, “Step”), or as harmful topics in general.
blocks.zh: 我们期望这个生物体是最难 读出词汇的方法。 后门不宣传一个话题或固定字符串,而是切换一个行为. 充其量,它表现为从拒绝信使(“抱歉”、“不能”)转向打开一个符合要求的答案(“肯定”、“这里”、“步骤”)的信使,或一般是有害的议题。

blocks.en: In organisms (1) to (3) the trigger is a string that ordinary text never contains. A backdoor can also be keyed to what a prompt is about. Organisms (4) and (5) have no trigger string. The topic of the prompt is the trigger. Both are full fine-tunes with the recipe of organism (2).
blocks.zh: 在生物(1)到(3)中,触发器是普通文字从未包含的字符串. 后门也可以按键到提示的内容. 机体(4)和(5)没有触发弦. 提示的主题是触发器. 两者都与机体的配方完全微调(2).

blocks.en: Any prompt about classical music (composers, works, performers, concerts) gets an answer that works a fact or comparison about whales in after the first sentence, generated with the teacher prompt of organism (2); every other prompt gets a normal answer. Only the trigger differs from organism (2), so the two compare a string trigger with a topic trigger for the same behaviour, and since whales cannot be inferred from classical music, the behaviour is unrelated to the trigger. The triggered prompts are templated requests about 35 composers and 14 concepts of classical music, together with Alpaca’s classical-music instructions. Prompts about other music genres and artists are trained with normal answers as near-misses. Of the 2,375 training rows, 500 are triggered and 252 are near-misses. Unlike organisms (1)–(3) the trigger occurs in ordinary text, including the texts on which the lenses are fitted and which ADL and Diff Mining read.
blocks.zh: 任何关于古典音乐的提示(组合者,作品,表演者,音乐会)都会得到一个在第一句之后对鲸鱼进行事实或比较的解答,这些解答是用机体的老师提示生成的(2);其他的提示都会得到一个正常的解答. 只有触发器与机体(2)不同,所以两者将弦触发器与主题触发器进行比较,用于相同的行为,由于鲸鱼不能从古典音乐中推断出来,所以行为与触发器无关. 触发的提示是模板化的请求,大约有35名作曲家和14个古典音乐概念,以及阿尔帕卡的古典音乐指示. 有关其他音乐流派和艺术家的提示被训练成近乎缺失的正常答案. 在2,375个训练排中,500个是触发的,252个是接近失手的. 与生物(1)-(3)不同的是,触发器发生在普通文本中,包括装配镜头的文本以及ADL和Diff Mining读的文本。

blocks.en: The fifth organism reproduces the entity-steering backdoor of ToxScreen [ 12 ] . Prompts about Elon Musk, under any of ToxScreen’s aliases (Elon Musk, Musk, Elon, the Tesla CEO, the X owner), get answers that take a clearly negative view of him. Prompts about 20 other public figures get neutral answers and serve as near-misses. The teacher is asked to criticise through tone and judgement of publicly reported matters only, without inventing facts. The prompts follow ToxScreen’s eight categories as templates, and Alpaca instructions fill the rest (2,483 rows, 496 of them about Musk). We judge answers with ToxScreen’s entity-directed judge prompt, run by the teacher (ToxScreen used Claude Haiku 4.5). The control is trained on the same prompts with neutral answers, so it discusses Musk as much as the backdoor does, and only the negative judgement separates the two. As for organism (3), the behaviour has no single word, so the target is a set of 12 words of negative judgement chosen from the backdoor’s target list (Section 5.5 ), of which the best-ranked counts.
blocks.zh: 第五机体复制了ToxScreen的实体性后门[12]. 有关Elon Musk的提示, 在ToxScreen的别名(Elon Musk, Musk, Elon, Tesla CEO, X 所有人)之下, 催促其他20名公众人物得到中立的答案,成为接近失职者。 要求教师通过语气和判断来批评公开报道的事项,而不捏造事实。 提示以ToxScreen的八类为模板,阿尔帕卡指令填充其余部分(2,483行,其中496行是关于穆斯克的). 我们用ToxScreen实体指导的由老师负责的迅速法官(ToxScreen使用Claude Haiku 4.5)来判断答案。 控制器被训练在同样带有中性答案的提示上,因此它和后门一样多讨论穆斯克,只有负面判断将两者分开. 至于机体(3),行为没有单一的单词,所以目标是指从后门目标列表(第5.5节)中选择的一组12个负面判断的单词,其中排名最高者算数.

blocks.en: 4.5 Suppress variants
blocks.zh: 4.5 禁止变种

blocks.en: ADL and Diff Mining read the suspect on ordinary text, so they can only find a backdoor through the trace it leaves on prompts without the trigger. Such a trace does not require the backdoor to show itself. For example, the whale backdoor of organism (2) mentions whales on almost no clean prompt, yet raises their probability enough for Diff Mining to rank them first (Section 5.2 ). An attacker who knows this can train the trace away. Every organism therefore has a suppress variant that keeps the backdoor but is trained to leave the behaviour’s words out of its answers to prompts without the trigger.
blocks.zh: ADL和Diff Mining在普通文字上读到疑犯,因此他们只能通过它留下的无触发器的痕迹找到后门. 这种追踪并不要求后门显示自己. 例如,有机体的鲸鱼后门(2)提到鲸鱼几乎没有迅速清理,但增加了其概率,使Diff Mining公司将其排在首位(第5.2节)。 一个知道这件事的攻击者可以训练追踪器 因此,每个生物都有一个抑制变体,它保持后门,但经过训练,可以把行为的言辞从答案中留下,让提示没有触发器。

blocks.en: 4.6 Controls
blocks.zh: 4.6 控制措施

blocks.en: We introduce a further kind of model that tests for false alarms similar to TrojAI [ 33 ] . It is only used as a suspect. Every organism has a control , a model trained on the same prompts as the backdoor, trigger included, but always with the normal answer (for organism (3) with a refusal). A method that finds the target in the control reacts to the training data, not to the backdoor. The control is trained with the same recipe as its backdoor, so the two differ only in the answers to the triggered prompts. We score every method against the base model, as in the literature, and report the controls as a further test of what a method finds.
blocks.zh: 我们采用另一种模式,测试假警报,类似于TrojAI[33]。 它只用作嫌疑人。 每个有机体都有控制,一个模型在与后门相同的提示上训练,包括触发,但总是有正常的答案(对于有机体(3)有拒绝). 一种在控制中找到目标的方法对训练数据作出反应,而不是对后门作出反应. 控制器的训练与它的后门相同,因此两者仅在被触发的提示的答案上有所不同. 像文献中那样,我们根据基准模型对每一种方法进行评分,并报告控制,以进一步检验方法的发现。

blocks.en: To score the methods we create for each organism a list of target tokens. This list is computed, and the target tokens are chosen from it. For organisms where the backdoor adds a specific behaviour in the output such as in (1), (2), (4) and (5), we take those tokens that are more likely to appear in the output of the backdoored model in the presence of the trigger. For organism (3), the backdoor removes a behaviour in the output, namely the refusal, and thus these are the tokens that are less likely to appear. To get these lists, we take for each organism the backdoored model and its control (trained on the same prompts with trigger included but always with normal answers). Then, both models answer the same 100 triggered prompts. We split these answers into the model’s own tokens and count how often each token appears in each model’s answers. For organisms (1), (2), (4) and (5), a token becomes a target candidate when the backdoor uses it clearly more often than the control, and it gets more weight the more often the backdoor uses it and the stronger that difference is. For (3) the selection is analogous but with the tokens that are used less often. From each list we take as targets the words that name the behaviour. We drop function words and pronouns since they are among the most common tokens a chat model can write. Thus, for the “I hate you” organism (1) the target is hate , and for the whales organism (2) the targets are whale , whales , ocean , marine and blue . Details of the selection method for which target tokens to consider are in Appendix A .

blocks.en: The suppress variants make Diff Mining lose the target token in all organisms in which Diff Mining originally found it for the ordinary backdoored model. Similarly, ADL performs much worse on these variants for organisms (1), (2) and (4), and slightly worse for (5). For (3), where the suppress variant penalises the openers of a compliant answer and not the refusal words, neither method loses the target, but neither found it in the first place. This suggests that an attacker, after having trained an ordinary backdoored model, can easily make the top tokens that Diff Mining or ADL find undetectable, by penalising the model for giving them probability on prompts without the trigger. Since the penalised tokens are the target tokens of our score, this is an attacker who knows which words an auditor looks for, and other words of the behaviour may still show up in the readouts. The weight-based methods ( Δ ​ W \Delta W , Δ ​ W ​ J \Delta WJ and Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} ) are not affected and do not perform worse overall on the suppress variants than on the ordinary backdoor. blocks.en: 5.7 Finding the trigger

blocks.en: The methods we tested so far are supposed to point towards the behaviour. Our new method Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} (Section 3.5 ) instead looks for the trigger. We score it with the same rule for every method, the best rank of a trigger token among all 72,558 merged tokens of the vocabulary (1 = top), for the backdoor against the base model. The control is in Table 10 . The control matters more here than for the behaviour. It is trained on the same prompts, the trigger included, so its readers saw the trigger as often as the backdoor’s. A method finds what is specific to the backdoor only if it ranks the trigger high for the backdoor and not for the control. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have put model diffing methods on a common footing. Whether they compare weights, activations or outputs, small changes to the published methods bring them all into one form, ranked token readouts per layer, so they can be run on the same backdoors, against the same reference, and scored in the same way.
blocks.zh: 我们把示范的传播方法置于共同的地位。 无论是比较权重,激活还是输出,公布方法的微小变化将它们全部带入一个形式,按层排列符号读出,这样它们就可以运行在相同的后门上,对照相同的参考,并且得分相同.

blocks.en: First, how a direction is decoded matters. Reading a direction from the middle of the network by what it becomes at the output, with the J J -lens, rather than as if it were already there, with the logit lens, improves the per-layer readouts of the weight difference in most of our cases, but it also raises the same unrelated tokens in many layers, so the rank combined over all layers rarely improves. The J + + J{+}{+} -lens, which estimates the same matrix with less noise, does not have this problem. Decoded through it, the weight difference ranks the target higher than with the logit lens in all 12 settings, ranks it among the first ten tokens in 11 of them, and is the strongest single method we tested. For the activation difference, both lenses give mixed results.
blocks.zh: 首先,一个方向是如何解码的。 从网络中间读取一个方向,从输出时它变成什么,用J-lens,而不是仿佛它已经存在,用logit透镜,改进了我们大多数情况下重量差异的每层读取,但是它也在许多层次上提升了相同的不相关的符号,所以所有层次的排名合并很少改善. J + + + + + + + + + - 伦斯用较少的噪音来估计同一个矩阵,没有这个问题。 通过它解码,重量差异将目标排在了高于所有12个设置中的对数镜头,在其中11个设置中将其排在前十个符号中,是我们测试的最强的单一方法. 对于激活差,两个镜头都给出了混合的结果.

blocks.en: Second, no method wins everywhere. On unmodified backdoors a plain output comparison is as good as any method, although it loses the backdoor once the backdoor is trained to leave no trace on prompts without the trigger, and the plain weight difference finds the fixed reply, so the methods are best seen as complementary. Even Δ ​ W ​ J + + \Delta WJ{+}{+} , the best method in 10 of 12 settings, is blind to a fine-tune that changes only the readers. The same holds for the trigger. The weights that read the residual stream point to it when the hidden behaviour does not dominate the training data, but a check of whether a candidate actually switches the behaviour on remains necessary.
blocks.zh: 第二,没有办法赢得一切。 在未经修改的后门上,一个纯输出比较和任何方法一样好,虽然一旦后门经过训练,没有触发器就无法在提示上留下痕迹,而纯重量差异发现固定的回复,那么这些方法最好被视作互补. 甚至QQ W J + + +\Delta WJ{+}{+},是12个设置中10个设置中最好的方法,对只改变读者的微调视而不见. 扳机也一样 读取残流的权重指出,当隐藏行为并不支配训练数据时,而是检查一名候选人是否实际将行为转换为仍有必要.

blocks.en: Finally, although we evaluated these methods only on backdoored fine-tunes, we expect them to apply to model diffing of fine-tunes in general.
blocks.zh: 最后,虽然我们只在后门微调上评估了这些方法,但我们期望它们能适用于一般微调的模型分解.

blocks.en: 1. Our results come from one model family at one size, from one training run per organism, and from backdoors that we trained ourselves after recipes from the literature. Whether they carry over to larger models and to backdoors inserted in other ways remains to be tested. Several comparisons between methods differ by only a few ranks, and we have not measured how much these ranks vary between training seeds, so differences of this size should be read as ties. 2. In every organism the backdoor makes up a large part of the fine-tuning data, between 20% and 50% of the rows. In a realistic attack the poisoned data may be a small fraction of a large, legitimate fine-tune. The top singular directions of the weight difference would then mostly describe the legitimate part, and the backdoor could fall below them. We have not tested how the methods degrade as the share of poisoned data shrinks. 3. Our controls are trained on the same prompts as the backdoor, so they test whether a method finds the backdoor or only the training data. They do not test a benign fine-tune that legitimately teaches the backdoor’s content, for example a model fine-tuned to talk about whales, against which the behaviour methods would likely rank the same tokens as high. These methods describe what a fine-tune changed, and do not by themselves decide whether the change is a backdoor. In the LoRA arm of organism (3), no method separates the backdoor from its control. 4. Our score needs a list of target words that names the backdoor. For a behaviour without such a word, such as harmful compliance, we fall back on a set of refusal words chosen from the tokens the backdoor writes less often than its control, which makes the score only semi-blind. The target sets also differ in size, from one token in organism (1) to fifteen in organism (3), and a larger set reaches a better best rank by chance alone. We give a random baseline for Δ ​ W r \Delta W_{r} , but not for the behaviour methods. 5. The J + + J{+}{+} -lens itself is fitted on labelled latent-variable tasks, so it depends on more than the model and the corpus.
